admin.title: Admin
admin.subtitle: {company} — workspace members, settings, and data export.
admin.inviteSectionHelp: We send a secure sign-in link by email. After they finish signing up, they appear under "Waiting for workspace" until you add them here or from Team.
admin.invitesNotConfigured: Email invites need a server-only secret configured on the host (not in the browser). Add SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY in your deployment environment—for example Render → your web service → Environment—then redeploy if the service was already running. For local development only, you can use a .env.local file.
admin.waitingEmpty: No pending signups. Invited people appear here after they create an account.
